listeners.description: SMTP listeners (interface, port, TLS, hostname). Each entry defines where SMTP is accepted.

domains.description: Domains this MTA is authoritative for. Required if not using automatic domain detection.

tables.description: Static or dynamic lookup tables (aliases, mailboxes, authentication, etc.).

routes.description: Custom mail routing rules. Each rule defines WHEN to accept mail and WHAT action to take.

default_domain.description: Primary local domain for default routing (fallback if no domains/routing defined).
